game.name: 1. Counting Beads
game.desc: Every press adds a bead and counts it, from 1 to 9. The bar takes its Montessori bead-stair color.

game.name: 2. Letter Sounds
game.desc: One letter at a time. Every press says its sound and a word: "mmm ... monkey".

game.name: 3. Number Pop
game.desc: Count from 0 to 9, one number at a time. Press any button to pop it, hear its name, and count the dots.

game.name: 4. Four Corners
game.desc: Four cards laid out like the buttons. Press a button to hear the card in that spot. Start switches letters and numbers.

game.name: 5. Where Is...?
game.desc: "Where is mmm?" Pick left or right. Start switches letters and numbers.

game.name: 6. What Is This?
game.desc: Play together: a card shows, he names it, then press to hear the answer. Start switches letters and numbers.

game.name: Balloon Pop
game.desc: Balloons float up. Press any button to pop one and hear its color.

game.name: Button Party
game.desc: Every button makes a burst of color and a happy note.

game.name: Croc
game.desc: Play with Croc! A chomps, B jumps, X waves hi, Y dances, the D-pad looks around, the shoulder buttons tickle, and Start says rawr.

game.name: Hungry Croc
game.desc: Feed Croc letters! Press any button and he chomps the card, then says its sound and word. Start switches to numbers.
